_note: Key: eclipse_type → natal_planet_activated → aspect_type. 2×12=24 blocks. ~100 words.
fallback: This timing note marks a concentrated pivot, not a fixed prediction. Eclipses tend to make a storyline harder to ignore: something may begin, culminate, close, or change emphasis. Let the symbolism meet the facts of your actual life. Capacity, consent, timing, practical information, and ordinary judgment still matter. The most useful response is rarely panic or passivity; it is noticing what has become visible and choosing one honest way to meet it.

Solar.fallback: A solar eclipse opens a fresh line of development. Its first signal may be small: a new priority, a door opening, a role shifting, or a desire becoming harder to dismiss. Do not force the whole chapter to announce itself at once. Notice what is beginning to ask for time, attention, and real-world support.
Solar.1: A solar eclipse touching your core direction can begin a new relationship with authorship: who you are becoming, what gives you energy, and where your life feels most recognizably yours. The signal may arrive as renewed confidence, dissatisfaction with an old role, or a quiet pull toward a more honest center. This is not about performing reinvention for an audience. It is about noticing which choices return vitality instead of draining it. Begin with what makes your direction easier to inhabit: a clearer yes, a cleaner no, or one visible act that matches the person you are trying to live as.
Solar.2: A solar eclipse in the territory of care, belonging, and bodily safety can begin a new private arrangement. Something about home, family, emotional rhythm, rest, or the conditions that help you settle may need to be treated as central rather than incidental. The first change may be modest: a room reorganized, a need spoken plainly, a pattern of bracing finally questioned. Let the body be part of the evidence. What repeatedly leaves you guarded is not neutral. Build from the smallest reliable forms of care, especially the ones that make daily life feel less like something you have to survive.
Solar.3: A solar eclipse activating your communication pattern can open a new chapter in language, learning, planning, or the local web of your days. A message, conversation, course of study, sibling or neighbor dynamic, document, or decision path may become newly important. The invitation is not to say more for the sake of saying more; it is to make meaning more accurate. Pay attention to which assumptions are ready to be checked. Write down what matters, ask the question beneath the first question, and give future-you the gift of agreements clear enough to return to.
Solar.4: A solar eclipse in the field of values, pleasure, resources, and reciprocity can begin a new standard. You may notice a different relationship with money, desire, beauty, creativity, affection, or the exchanges that make a bond feel mutual. The first sign may be attraction as much as discomfort: what you want more of, what no longer feels worth the cost, or what your taste is beginning to reveal. Let your standards become usable rather than theoretical. Track what nourishes, what extracts, what repeats, and what can be named without bargaining your self-respect down.
Solar.5: A solar eclipse activating drive, courage, conflict, and physical energy can begin a new way of acting. You may feel a sharper relationship to anger, desire, competition, initiative, or the limits of your stamina. The question is not whether you are allowed to move; it is what kind of movement actually serves the situation. Impulse can provide information, but it does not have to set the whole agenda. Choose the clean action: the sentence that needs saying, the task that needs starting, the boundary that needs a verb, or the pause that keeps force from becoming waste.
Solar.6: A solar eclipse in the territory of belief, growth, study, travel, and future possibility can open a wider horizon. A plan may begin to call for more faith, more education, a longer route, or a more generous interpretation of what your life can hold. Still, possibility becomes trustworthy when it has a vessel. Notice what expands your world without asking you to abandon discernment. The useful beginning may be a class, application, itinerary, spiritual question, or promise to follow curiosity past its first spark. Let enthusiasm meet calendar, cost, support, and follow-through.
Solar.7: A solar eclipse touching responsibility, limits, and long-term structure can begin a more adult agreement with time. Duties, commitments, authority, boundaries, or credibility may shift from background pressure into active design. This does not have to feel glamorous to matter. A schedule, contract, role, deadline, or repair plan may become the seed of a sturdier chapter. Instead of trying to prove endurance, ask what structure would make the commitment livable. The beginning may be small and sober: naming ownership, reducing ambiguity, protecting maintenance time, or choosing the rule that keeps the whole system from leaning on willpower alone.
Solar.8: A solar eclipse activating freedom, experimentation, disruption, and future-facing connection can begin through deviation. A friendship, group, technology, creative idea, community role, or independence need may push you outside the old route. The point is not rebellion as a personality costume; it is discovering where more room is genuinely required. Treat the new impulse like a prototype. Test it where the stakes are manageable. Let feedback tell you which version of freedom gives you more life, not just more escape. The useful beginning may look strange at first because it belongs to a future your old habits cannot fully recognize.
Solar.9: A solar eclipse in the realm of imagination, sensitivity, compassion, art, and spiritual life can begin quietly. The new chapter may appear as a dream, longing, creative pull, need for solitude, or softening of an identity that has been held too tightly. Because this terrain can blur edges, keep the practical world within reach. Make room for intuition without requiring it to replace evidence. The beginning may be a ritual, rest practice, artistic container, therapeutic support, or more honest boundary with overwhelm. Let mystery have space, but do not let vagueness make every decision for you.
Solar.10: A solar eclipse touching depth, shared resources, intimacy, grief, and power can begin a consequential inner negotiation. Something hidden may not be ready for public explanation, but it may still require a different agreement with trust, consent, debt, dependency, inheritance, or emotional exposure. This is not a prompt to become suspicious of everything. It is an invitation to notice where leverage lives and whether responsibility is being named accurately. Begin by making the invisible ledger more honest. What is owed, shared, protected, desired, withheld, or grieved? One clear term can change the whole room.
Solar.11: A solar eclipse activating presence, embodiment, and first contact can begin a new way of entering your own life. Appearance, style, pace, health, name, access, or the immediate impression you make may become part of a larger reorientation. This is not superficial if it changes how you move through the world. The body often registers identity before language catches up. Notice which daily signals tell the truth more cleanly: how you dress, arrive, answer, rest, decline, or take up space. Let the outer adjustment support an inner recognition instead of replacing it.
Solar.12: A solar eclipse in the field of contribution, reputation, leadership, and public responsibility can begin a new visible chapter. The change may involve career direction, authority, accountability, recognition, or the work that carries your name into the world. Do not confuse the first step with the whole legacy. What matters now is making the next credible move, especially if the old definition of success has started to feel too narrow. Document the work. Clarify the role. Build private support for public effort. A meaningful contribution needs more than ambition; it needs conditions that can hold the weight of being seen.

Lunar.fallback: A lunar eclipse brings something into fuller visibility. A feeling, pattern, agreement, result, or ending may become harder to minimize. Release can mean completion, grief, renegotiation, changed terms, or simply no longer pretending not to know what you know. Let the information settle before turning it into a final verdict.
Lunar.1: A lunar eclipse touching your core direction can reveal where vitality has been spent, protected, or misdirected. Something about identity, confidence, purpose, or visible authorship may become difficult to ignore. The point is not to deliver an instant verdict on who you are. It is to notice what the year has already shown: which roles give energy back, which ones require too much self-abandonment, and where consistency has made your true direction visible. Let the revelation become practical. Protect the life that actually animates you, and stop giving your best force to a version of yourself that no longer fits.
Lunar.2: A lunar eclipse in the territory of care, home, belonging, and bodily safety can show what your nervous system has been carrying. A family pattern, domestic condition, emotional habit, caregiving role, or need for rest may reach a point of undeniable clarity. Release does not have to look dramatic. Sometimes it is the end of pretending a setup is comfortable when your body has been saying otherwise for months. Let tenderness and logistics sit at the same table. Food, sleep, privacy, repair, and reliable support are not decorative needs. They are part of the evidence.
Lunar.3: A lunar eclipse activating communication, learning, logistics, and daily stories can bring a conversation, document, decision, or pattern of interpretation to a head. Something may finally be said plainly, or you may recognize how much has been built on assumption. The useful release here is often informational: outdated narratives, unclear agreements, unfinished messages, or a planning style that keeps creating avoidable confusion. Let the facts become kinder than guesswork. Ask what changed, what was misunderstood, and what needs to be recorded so everyone is not forced to keep rebuilding the same bridge from memory.
Lunar.4: A lunar eclipse in the field of values, pleasure, resources, and reciprocity can reveal the true cost of an exchange. You may see what has been nourishing, what has been performative, what has become expensive in more than one sense, or where affection and obligation have been tangled together. This clarity does not require immediate severance. It may ask for a cleaner price, a more honest desire, a repair of mutual effort, or permission to receive without apology. Let your body’s response to beauty, ease, generosity, and depletion count. Standards become real when they change what you continue to choose.
Lunar.5: A lunar eclipse touching drive, courage, anger, and action can expose where energy has been overused, blocked, or pointed at the wrong target. A conflict may culminate, a desire may become undeniable, or a pattern of pushing through may show its bill. The release here is not necessarily retreat. It may be the end of scattered force. Notice which fight is actually yours, which urgency belongs to someone else, and where direct action would be cleaner than resentment. Let anger provide a location, not a complete strategy. Then choose the move that leaves the least residue.
Lunar.6: A lunar eclipse in the territory of belief, study, travel, and long-range possibility can reveal whether a horizon is still alive for you. A plan, course, spiritual framework, legal matter, trip, publication, or future story may reach a moment of consequence. Something may be complete; something may need new terms; something may need to be released because it promised expansion while quietly shrinking your life. Let the evidence refine your faith. The question is not whether to dream smaller, but whether the dream has enough truth, structure, and lived desire to keep asking for your participation.
Lunar.7: A lunar eclipse activating responsibility, limits, credibility, and time can bring a commitment into full relief. A duty, deadline, authority dynamic, boundary, contract, or long-term plan may reveal what it has actually required. This is where endurance stops being an abstract virtue and becomes a practical accounting. What has held? What has depended on invisible labor? What consequence has been avoided? Release may mean simplifying the structure, naming ownership, completing an obligation, or admitting that a role has outgrown its original terms. Let maturity mean accurate stewardship, not carrying every loose end in silence.
Lunar.8: A lunar eclipse in the field of freedom, experimentation, community, and disruption can reveal where the old route has already broken open. A friendship, network, future plan, technology, or independence need may show what can no longer be managed through compliance. This does not require chaos for its own sake. It asks you to distinguish liberation from reaction. What change has evidence behind it? Which community actually makes room for your difference? What version of freedom still respects your nervous system, resources, and relationships? Let the revelation clear space for the future that has been knocking, not merely the one that helps you flee.
Lunar.9: A lunar eclipse touching imagination, compassion, spirituality, art, and rest can illuminate what has been dissolving beneath the surface. A dream may fade, a longing may sharpen, a fantasy may lose its hold, or a tender truth may become easier to feel than explain. Do not rush to translate everything into certainty. Some releases happen through grief, sleep, prayer, creative work, or the quiet decision to stop feeding an illusion. Keep enough structure nearby to protect your sensitivity. The gift is not confusion; it is a more honest relationship with what your spirit can and cannot keep absorbing.
Lunar.10: A lunar eclipse in the territory of depth, intimacy, shared resources, grief, and power can bring hidden arrangements into focus. What has been owed, withheld, merged, feared, desired, or controlled may become harder to keep unnamed. This clarity can be intense because it touches survival logic, not just preference. Move carefully, but do not minimize what the evidence shows. Release may mean renegotiating consent, changing a financial or emotional entanglement, grieving a version of trust, or refusing to let vigilance become your only safety plan. The honest term is the beginning of a different kind of power.
Lunar.11: A lunar eclipse activating presence, embodiment, appearance, and first contact can reveal how you are being met—and how you are meeting yourself. A physical signal, identity marker, style choice, health rhythm, or pattern of self-presentation may become newly meaningful. This is not about judging the surface. It is about recognizing where the surface has been carrying an inner truth, or hiding one. Release the signals that make you harder to recognize to yourself. Adjust access, pace, presentation, and immediate boundaries so your daily presence does not have to keep apologizing for the person it actually belongs to.
Lunar.12: A lunar eclipse in the field of contribution, reputation, career, and public authority can show what your visible role has become. Recognition, responsibility, fatigue, ambition, leadership, or accountability may reach a culmination. The question is not only whether the world approves. It is whether the role still reflects the work you are willing to stand behind. Some chapters end through achievement; others through the honest discovery that public success has been leaning on private depletion. Let the result teach you about structure. Keep the contribution that has integrity, and change the conditions that make visibility cost too much.
